title: MVP V3 Sprint 3: demo genesis package and public devnet runbook
mvp_checklist: docs/CONCEPT_ROADMAP.md MVP V3 tasks: Demo genesis package, public devnet runbook
brief: Build the MVP V3 public-devnet demo package: reproducible demo genesis, validator set/topology, runbook and API smoke. The demo genesis must align with the Whitepaper-level premine target of 21 billion PWM, with raw-unit scale documented and verified. The package should let an external tester start a clean local devnet without manually crafting tmp/genesis-custom.json or reading source code.
requirements: Demo genesis premine target: 21,000,000,000 PWM at the code's canonical raw scale.
Document exact raw-unit conversion and where the premine is allocated.
Keep this as public devnet/demo material, not production security posture.
Do not change consensus/economic policy outside what is required to generate and verify the demo genesis package.

slices.title: Map genesis builder, devnet scripts, runbooks, and API smoke
acceptance: pwm-info produces a reusable map of how to generate/load genesis and run current devnet/CY lab.
The map identifies canonical PWM raw scale and how to express 21B PWM in genesis.
The map calls out current manual tmp/genesis-custom.json assumptions.

slices.title: Freeze demo topology and premine allocation
acceptance: Node roles, ports, domains, state roots, and validator identities are specified.
Premine allocation sums to 21B PWM at raw scale.
Runbook states demo/devnet assumptions and non-production posture.

slices.title: Create reproducible demo genesis package/runbook path
acceptance: External tester has a one-command or near-one-command path to generate/use demo genesis.
No hidden dependency on pre-existing tmp/genesis-custom.json remains in the primary demo path.
The generated/packaged genesis can be checked for 21B PWM premine.

slices.title: API smoke linked from docs/api-v1.md
acceptance: Runbook includes /v1/status and minimal account/head smoke.
The smoke references docs/api-v1.md without duplicating unstable wire details.
Testing can run the smoke on clean state roots.

slices.title: Independent review of Sprint V3-3
acceptance: Any mechanical PASS_WITH_NITS items are auto-closed by the orchestrator conveyor.

delegations.prompt_summary: Map current genesis builder/load paths, demo/CY scripts, runbooks, API smoke, raw scale, and 21B PWM premine representation.
Implement demo genesis package/runbook path with 21B PWM premine verification and public devnet smoke docs/scripts.
Validate generated/packaged demo genesis, 21B premine sum, clean-run public devnet path, and API smoke commands.
Independent review of Sprint V3-3 demo genesis/public devnet package, Whitepaper premine alignment, and runbook reproducibility.
